_comment: Evals for the peak-specific trip briefing skill. Schema follows c:\Users\midavids\.agents\skills\skill-creator\references\schemas.md. Trip briefings depend on live data (NWS, NWAC, SNOTEL) — for offline eval runs, expectations focus on the inputs the skill must consult and the structure of its output, not on specific numbers.

evals.prompt: Generate a trip briefing for Mount Daniels this Sunday. We're thinking a ski tour.
evals.expected_output: A go/no-go briefing covering weather, snowpack, avalanche, drive time, and route plan for Mt Daniels.
expectations: Output reads skills/trip-briefing/references/bulger-peaks.json to look up Daniels' coordinates / SNOTEL / NWAC zone
Output fetches an NWS point forecast for the peak
Output fetches the NWAC avalanche forecast for Daniels' zone
Output fetches at least one nearby SNOTEL reading
Output gives an explicit go / no-go / conditional recommendation
Output includes drive time from North Bend, WA

evals.prompt: Plan a go/no-go for Forbidden Peak West Ridge this Saturday.
evals.expected_output: Peak-specific briefing biased to a technical alpine rock objective.
expectations: Output identifies Forbidden Peak via the bulger-peaks.json record
Output addresses West Ridge route specifically (not the East Ridge or NW Face)
Output considers freezing levels / approach snow conditions appropriate to season
Output flags Cascade River Road access status

evals.prompt: Trip briefing for Jack Mountain via the Nohokomeen Headwall on June 8th.
evals.expected_output: Briefing that consults personal route beta (cached in bulger-knowledge) plus live weather.
expectations: Output consults bulger-knowledge cached beta on Jack/Nohokomeen (the bergschrund window)
Output reports an explicit assessment of whether the bergschrund is likely passable on the given date
Output gives the Ross Dam → East Bank Trail → May Creek approach
Output addresses the multi-day vs single-day overnight question

evals.prompt: Quick conditions check on Mount Adams this weekend — corn cycle window?
evals.expected_output: Briefing biased to a volcanic ski-mountaineering objective.
expectations: Output identifies Mount Adams via bulger-peaks.json
Output addresses corn-snow conditions (freeze-thaw cycle, overnight low, aspect, elevation)
Output considers South Climb route as the default ski-mountaineering line
Output gives a recommended departure time from North Bend or trailhead
